task.description:
Write unit test specifications and test source files for API-08 (Bearer token auth).

Create test spec at tests/specs/API-08.md covering:
- TC-API-08-01: Missing Authorization header → HTTP 401 + WWW-Authenticate
- TC-API-08-02: Malformed header (no Bearer prefix) → HTTP 401
- TC-API-08-03: Unknown/revoked token → HTTP 401
- TC-API-08-04: Valid bootstrap token → authenticated as PLATFORM_ADMIN
- TC-API-08-05: Valid token but insufficient role → HTTP 403
- TC-API-08-06: Valid token with sufficient role → pass through
- TC-API-08-07: BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN in production → fatal startup error
- TC-API-08-08: Empty bootstrap token → treated as not set

Write test source files under tests/unit/ for the auth middleware.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-08.md created with all test cases
Test source files created under tests/unit/
All test cases cover API-08 acceptance criteria
Edge cases covered: malformed header, bootstrap token, production safety

result.summary: Created test spec tests/specs/API-08.md (10 test cases: 6 unit, 3 integration, 1 defensive skip) and unit test file tests/unit/test_api08_auth.zig (9 tests: 4 pass, 5 skip-conditional). Fixed auth.zig Zig 0.16 compatibility issues (std.posix.getenv → std.c.getenv, Sha256.hash 3-arg signature, fmtSliceHexLower → bytesToHex, error union discard). Updated build.zig with api_mod link_libc and api08 test module registration.
